script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Lord Weavers ji — main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon. Seedha baat karta hoon: aapka account pichle poore 30 din mein ek bhi din active nahi raha, aur is wajah se last month zero enquiries aayi hain — ek bhi lead nahi. 8,600 din se aap hamare saath hain, toh yeh situation hum dono ke liye concern ki baat hai.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai, mujhe samajhna hai — kya aapko lag raha hai ki buyers aapko platform pe dhundh hi nahi pa rahe, ya koi aur issue hai jaise product listing ya pricing? Kyunki aapka CQS score abhi 39 hai, jo 100 mein se bahut low hai, aur iska seedha matlab hai buyers search mein aapko skip kar dete hain.
script_parts.value_demo: Ek important data point share karta hoon — is waqt aapke category mein demand tier 'Red' hai, matlab market mein buyers hain lekin har paid seller ko average 0 BLs mil rahe hain, trend flat hai. Iska matlab competition mein jo seller apna CQS 70+ rakhta hai, woh jo bhi limited leads aa rahi hain unhe capture kar leta hai — aap unhe miss kar rahe hain sirf catalog aur settings ki wajah se.
script_parts.action: Toh abhi is call pe hi ek kaam karte hain — main aapka catalog open karta hoon aur hum milke top 3 products ke images, description aur keywords update karte hain taaki CQS 39 se upar aaye. Sirf 10 minute lagenge aur yeh sabse quick win hai jo aaj ho sakta hai.
script_parts.close: Bhai, main aapko force nahi kar raha — bas ek request hai ki agle 7 din mein sirf 15 minute roz platform pe login karein aur jo changes hum aaj karte hain unhe verify karein. Ek follow-up call 7 din baad rakhte hain — agar tab bhi leads nahi aayi toh hum next step discuss karenge, deal?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, Lord Weavers ji — calling from IndiaMART. I'll be direct: your account had zero active days in the last 30 days, which resulted in zero enquiries — not a single lead last month. You've been with us for over 8,600 days, so this situation is a concern for both of us.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: I want to understand — do you feel buyers simply aren't finding you on the platform, or is there another issue like product listings or pricing? Because your CQS score is currently 39 out of 100, which is critically low, and it directly means buyers are skipping past you in search results.
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's an important data point — your category is currently in the 'Red' demand tier, meaning the market shows 0 BLs per paid seller with a flat trend. What this means is that the few leads that do come in are being captured by sellers who maintain a CQS of 70+, while you're missing out purely due to catalog and settings gaps.
script_parts_en.action: So let's do one concrete thing right now on this call — I'll pull up your catalog and together we'll update the images, descriptions, and keywords on your top 3 products to push your CQS above 39. It'll take just 10 minutes and it's the fastest win we can achieve today.
script_parts_en.close: I'm not pressuring you — just one request: log in for 15 minutes a day over the next 7 days and verify the changes we make today. Let's schedule a follow-up call in 7 days — if leads still haven't improved by then, we'll discuss the next step together. Does that work for you?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
